subject: Triggered upsize & co-term consolidation + auto-renew alignment
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@nimbushealth.com>, NimbusHealth Procurement <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal alignment – triggered upsize window & co-term proposal

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for the thoughtful conversation yesterday. Per our discussion, I pulled together the operational approach we recommend for the upcoming renewal so your teams have predictability while preserving flexibility as usage ramps into Q2. High-level proposal attached (Nimbus_Onramp_RampSchedule_v3.xlsx).

Key asks from your side:
- Confirm desired contract boundary to co-term with your fiscal year (we noted 2027-01-01 as target).
- Confirm whether the triggered upsize should be automatic at 80% of the reserved capacity for two consecutive months, or opt-in via PO.
- Procurement requested an example amendment to expedite legal — included a skeleton (CoTerm_Amendment_Draft.pdf) to accelerate redlines.

Proposed practical flow:
1) Co-term the baseline to 2027-01-01 with a 24-month term thereafter.
2) Implement a triggered upsize clause: when average monthly token consumption across prod routes hits 80% of the monthly reserved token capacity for 2 months, Redwood performs a capacity uplift equal to +25% of the current committed capacity.
3) Customer can opt-out of automatic uplift by providing a PO within 10 business days of trigger; otherwise uplift is applied and billed pro-rata for the remainder of the month and at the contracted rate going forward.
4) Auto-renew remains on; customer may elect to disable auto-renew at the next renewal window with 60 days notice.

Next steps: can you confirm procurement contact for the amendment review cycle and whether legal prefers the DocuSign flow (link below) or an attached redline? Once we have that, Camila will draft an implementation checklist for onboarding the increased capacity.

—Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Nimbus_Onramp_RampSchedule_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), CoTerm_Amendment_Draft.pdf (draft amendment)

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@nimbushealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: NimbusHealth Procurement <procurement@nimbushealth.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 12:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal alignment – triggered upsize window & co-term proposal

Karthik —

Appreciate the clear summary and the two draft files. A few quick items from our side:
1) Fiscal alignment: yes, target co-term of 2027-01-01 works. We run FY starting Jan 1.
2) Trigger logic: procurement would prefer an opt-in PO approach rather than an automatic uplift to avoid surprise budget hits. That said, product wants the safety of an automatic uplift during clinical spikes. Could we do a middle ground: auto-notify + 10 business day opt-out via PO? If no opt-out, uplift applies.
3) Billing: we need pro-rata invoices and an advisory notice at least 5 business days prior to uplift billing.
4) Legal asked that the draft amendment include a 90-day exit window for any material SLA regressions post-upsize.

Procurement contact is me (procurement@ NimbusHealth). For the amendment, we prefer DocuSign. Please send the link and our legal will review redlines; expedite if you can.

Thanks —
Priya
Head of Cloud Platforms
NimbusHealth

Thanks Priya — that middle-ground approach makes sense and matches what we've seen work in other healthcare customers. Quick notes on operational readiness and timeline: 

Operational checklist (draft):
- Legal: finalize redline on the CoTerm_Amendment_Draft.pdf and confirm DocuSign signer list (target: 5 business days).
- Billing: set up pro-rata invoice curve and a pre-billing advisory email (5 business days prior).
- Ops: create a canary uplift plan — staged capacity increase applied to non-critical routes for first 72 hours, then full production promotion if no regressions.
- Monitoring: enable detailed latency/cost telemetry for the first 30 days post-upsize; set a rollback guard if token latency or error rates degrade >15% vs baseline.

Timeline proposal:
- Nov 4–10: Legal review and redline cycle
- Nov 11–17: Finalize amendment and DocuSign send 
- Jan 1, 2027: Co-term effective date; uplift triggers can occur after Jan 1 per agreed logic

I attached a condensed implementation timeline as well (see Nimbus_Onramp_RampSchedule_v3.xlsx). Jordan — can you draft the brief (2–3 bullet) internal runbook for our support engineers that we can share with Nimbus? I can own the onboarding checklist and monitoring playbook.

—Camila

Brief runbook attached below; happy to iterate with your SREs if you want to lock on the canary routes. TL;DR for internal teams at Nimbus: 
- Trigger detection: Redwood will send "Pre-Upsize Advisory" when rolling 2-month avg hits 80% of committed tokens.
